concept: Instance Scheduler / EventBridge: stopping dev instances after hours
tests: How to automatically stop and start dev EC2 on a schedule with the LEAST operational overhead.
expected: AWS Instance Scheduler or EventBridge scheduled rules — stop/start instances on a business-hours schedule. Triggers: "only needed during business hours", "safely stopped at other times", "least operational overhead".
why_not: Manual stopping — errors and toil; Reserved Instances assume constant use; Spot risks interruptions for a stable dev environment.
